name: Sentry
summary: Search errors, triage issues, inspect traces, and read logs from Sentry directly inside your coding agent.
description: Sentry's hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP (https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp). Built for coding agents: error search, issue triage, performance traces and log access. Connects via OAuth, or with a Sentry auth token in clients that send a custom Authorization header.
author: Sentry
